When it does appear, it sits later and more variably in the case (mean relative position about 0.50 vs 0.36; 75th percentile about 0.86 vs 0.38), and its outgoing transitions are spread over roughly 19 targets instead of concentrating on A19 (about 50%) and A20 (about 44%), which now receive only about 11% and 2%. - The same drop shows up relationally: for A06 paired with A14, A15, A19, A20, A30, A31, A38, A43 or A44, co-occurrence falls from about 63 to about 20 in 100 traces, while "partner occurs without A06" rises from about 37 to about 80 in 100. [REL001, REL003, REL007]
- A38 now rarely leads to A06: the A06 share of A38's outgoing transitions falls from about 60% to about 3%, while A19 and A20 rise to about 44% and 42%. [DIR006]
- A30 and A31 still occur in every trace, but each happens about once per trace instead of about 1.6 times; repetition falls from about 37 in 100 traces to near zero, A31→A31 repeats drop from 74 to 2 traces, A31→A30 from 73 to 1, and A31's outgoing transitions go almost entirely to A25 (about 97%, up from about 63%). [OCC005, OCC006, DIR005, LAG013, LAG014]
- Interleaved execution among A14, A19, A20, A30, A31, A38, A43 and A44 largely disappears: co-occurrence stays at 100 in 100 traces, but strict one-after-the-other ordering rises from about 63 to about 97–99 in 100, and lags concentrate (A19→A30 within 1–2 steps in about 97 in 100 observations; A30→A31 at 1 step in about 97 in 100, up from about 35). [REL010, REL016, REL017, LAG008, LAG012]
- A02, A04 and A10 are executed in more cases (A10 in about 26 in 100 traces vs 6; A02 about 15 vs 5.5; A04 about 15.5 vs 5), A10's outgoing transitions spread over about 20 targets, and small new successor shares (a few percent each) from A14, A15 and A43 towards A10, A02, A04 and A06 slightly lower the previously near-total A14→A15 (about 97% to 81%), A15→A16 (about 98% to 91%) and A43→A44 (about 97% to 85%) shares. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural reorganisation with three visible facets: in the later window A06 is executed in a much smaller share of cases (about 20 in 100 traces, down from about 63) and A38 rarely routes to it; A30 and A31 are executed once, in a fixed A30-then-A31 sequence, instead of being repeated and interleaved with their surroundings; and A02, A04 and A10 appear in a larger share of cases, including as low-share successors after A14, A15 and A43. [OCC003, OCC005, OCC006, DIR005, DIR006, REL010, REL016, LAG012, OCC004, DIR003]

Limitations: the rises in A02, A04 and A10 start from only about 10–12 traces in the earlier window, so sampling differences in variant frequencies could account for part of them, and A06's after-window routing and position rest on only about 39–45 traces; the evidence also cannot tell whether the A06 drop and the tightened ordering are one combined rerouting or two separate changes, and an unobserved edge such as A31→A30 is not proof that it was removed from the process. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, POS001, DIR005, LAG013]
